description: THE canonical discworld instance: 2 objects, 40 frames, 128 rays, obs_noise_std 0.2, position_noise_std 0.04 ('pn04'), fixed reflectivities, always_in_frustum, open boundary. All three parts verified to share this sim config; the pn04 name exists because dataset 17 silently used position noise 0.0 and its results were uninterpretable against this eval set.

train.format: flat float32 memmap obs.f32 (N, 40, 128) + meta.h5; see train/corpus.json
train.seed_law: shard k covers base seeds 10_000_000 + k*500_000_000 .. +500_000; retries offset by +1M per attempt (max 300), so the 500M stride and 500k shard size make collisions impossible. Verified: 0 duplicate seeds, disjoint from eval and legacy dset17.
train.notes: data-scale rungs are strict prefixes of this pool (mask, never regenerate); val = the LAST 2M sequences

probe_train.notes: probe fitting only; the 80/20 held-out split is BY SEQUENCE inside the fit. Sized so MLP-128 probes stay out of the memorisation regime (>=10 rows/param).

edits.notes: THE editability bench: every Edit Index in the project is scored on the first 192 of these (pim.environments.discworld.bench, K_ROLL=15)

provenance.eval: was datasets/4_fixed_refl_inview (generated 2026-08; seed 42 config, split base seeds 0/90k/100k/110k)

seed_disjointness: train seeds [10.0e6, 19.51e9] vs eval/edits seeds [0, 120k) vs probe seeds [9.0e11, ...) — pairwise disjoint by construction and verified (train/corpus.json)
